# Copilot instructions

This repository practises Spec-Driven Development and is governed by a constitution.
Copilot reads `AGENTS.md` in addition to this file; the authoritative sources are below,
and this file only points at them — it restates none of their rules, so there is one copy
to keep current.

- **`constitution.md`** — the binding principles (C1–C9), each with the mechanism that
  enforces it. It outranks this file and any prompt. If asked to do something that
  conflicts with it, say so instead of complying.
- **`AGENTS.md`** — the operating manual: the phases and their `prompts/` bodies, the
  non-negotiables, the provenance rules, the human checkpoints, `sdd.config.yml`, and what
  `node scripts/spec-lint.mjs` does and does not enforce.

Read both before proposing a change. Do not summarize them here.
